blocks.text: Nylon aik masnoo polyamide hai, jo condensation polymerisation se, aam taur par do mukhtalif monomers se banta hai: aik diamine, H2N-R-NH2, aur aik dicarboxylic acid, HOOC-R'-COOH; aik chhota molecule, aam taur par paani, nikalta hai. Nylon-6,6 sab se aam misal hai: yeh hexane-1,6-diamine aur hexanedioic acid se banta hai, har aik mein chhe carbon atoms: n H2N-(CH2)6-NH2 + n HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH -> [-NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)4-CO-]n + 2n H2O.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is acid ko '1,4-hexanedioic acid' likhti hai. Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, ke dono COOH carbons zanjeer ke C1 aur C6 hain, is liye sahi naam hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid) hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qataar: H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, har aik ke N-H, C=O aur OH bonds ke saath. Teer se zanjeer ...-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-..., pehli unit magenta mein, aur chaaron C=O ke neeche +H2O.
blocks.caption: Nylon-6,6 ki tayyari (kitab ke PDF safha 150 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magenta hissa aik repeat unit hai: aik diamine aur aik diacid. Har -NH2 ka H aur har -COOH ka OH mil kar paani bante hain, is liye har C=O ke neeche +H2O likha hai. Kitab ki chhapi zanjeer mein teesre N aur (CH2)6 ke darmiyan bond chhoot gaya hai; hum ne yeh bond bana diya hai.

Nylon-6 aik hi monomer, caprolactam, se banta hai jis ki banawat halqa daar hai; is ka naam nylon-6 is liye hai ke monomer mein chhe carbon atoms hain. Halqa khul kar [-NH-(CH2)5-CO-]n deta hai. Yeh aam condensation nahi kyunke koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta, lekin amide links ke banne ke tareeqe ki wajah se nylon-6 ko condensation polymer mana jata hai. Kitab nylon-6 ko nylon-6,6 se zyada hamwar satah aur zyada jhatke ki bardasht wala, aur kam pighalne ke darje ki wajah se dhalne mein aasan batati hai; yeh rollers, skateboard ke pahiyon aur power tools ke handles mein use hota hai.

blocks.alt: Teen caprolactam halqe, har aik C(=O), N(H) aur paanch CH2 groups ka saat rukni halqa. Teer se zanjeer ...C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH..., aakhri unit hari, naam Nylon 6.
blocks.caption: Caprolactam se nylon-6 ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 150 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Caprolactam ka halqa (ring) C-N bond par khulta hai aur khule halqe aapas mein jur jate hain, koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta. Hari unit aik khula hua caprolactam hai: -C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-.

blocks.prompt: Nylon-6,10 ka repeating unit -NH-(CH2)6-NH-CO-(CH2)8-CO- hai. Is ke monomers kya hain?
blocks.explanation: Hexane-1,6-diamine, H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, aur decanedioic acid, HOOC-(CH2)8-COOH (ya is ka dioyl chloride, ClOC-(CH2)8-COCl).

blocks.prompt: Nylon-6,4 ke monomers H2N(CH2)6NH2 aur HOOC(CH2)2COOH hain. Repeating unit batayein.

items: Nylon-6,6: hexane-1,6-diamine + hexanedioic acid; paani nikalta.
Nylon-6: caprolactam ka halqa khulna; koi chhota molecule nahi.
